Help.About.Title: About
Help.About.Body:
DevProjex is a tool for quickly preparing project context: visualize the structure, select the needed files, and copy the tree or contents to the clipboard. This is convenient for code analysis, code review, learning, and working with AI assistants when it is important to convey the project structure quickly and accurately.

The application operates only in read-only mode and does not modify files.

DevProjex is an open-source project licensed under GPL-3.0. The source code is open for study and modification; architectural suggestions and improvements (PRs) are welcome as part of the project's development.

Terminal.Tui.Welcome.HelpBody:
Up/Down or j/k moves through actions; Enter opens the selected action.
Esc closes a dialog and returns here without exiting. ? or F1 opens this help.
Long operations show their state. Esc or Ctrl+C cancels the active operation first.
Only Exit or q on this root screen closes DevProjex Terminal.
No project is scanned until you choose it. Use analyze and export for direct automation.

Terminal.Tui.HelpBody:
Up/Down or j/k navigates. Left/Right collapses or expands; Enter opens; Space toggles selection.
Tab or Shift+Tab switches the tree and preview. 1/2/3 changes the preview; F changes its format.
/ searches. M selects Git filtering; X edits Exclusions; R selects roots; T selects file types.
A analyzes; E exports context; Z exports a project copy; P saves a portable profile; G opens Desktop.
Esc closes the current overlay or returns one level. Ctrl+C cancels an active operation first.
Only q on the root workspace exits. Results and recoverable errors return you to this workspace.
